content.short: OpenSea is a decentralized NFT marketplace for buying, selling, collecting and gifting NFTs.
content.description: OpenSea, founded by Devin Finzer and Alex Atallah in 2017, is a decentralized marketplace for buying and selling NFTs. Users can buy, collect, trade, and gift NFTs on the platform. Developers can leverage OpenSea.js to run their own marketplaces and access the OpenSea API for data on sales, listings, bids, and transfers. The platform features one of the lowest commission rates for NFT purchases and sales. OpenSea has raised over $427M, including a $300M Series C from investors such as Coatue and Paradigm.
